overview.pt_bumi_morowali_utama_bmu_is: PT Bumi Morowali Utama (BMU) is a limited liability company (Perseroan Terbatas) registered in Indonesia and headquartered in Jakarta. The company is primarily engaged in the exploration, mining, and sales of nickel ore resources. BMU’s mining concession is located in Morowali Regency, Central Sulawesi (Kabupaten Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah), covering an area of 1,963 hectares. This region is among the most resource-rich areas in Indonesia, known for its concentrated nickel reserves and active mining and smelting operations.

profile.pt_bumi_morowali_utama_hereinafter_refer: PT Bumi Morowali Utama (hereinafter referred to as BMU) is a limited liability company (Perseroan Terbatas) registered in Indonesia and headquartered in Jakarta. The company is primarily engaged in the exploration, mining, and sales of nickel ore resources. BMU’s mining concession is located in Morowali Regency, Central Sulawesi (Kabupaten Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah), covering an area of 1,963 hectares. This region is among the most resource-rich areas in Indonesia, known for its concentrated nickel reserves and active mining and smelting operations.
profile.bmu_s_mining_resources_primarily_consist: BMU’s mining resources primarily consist of laterite nickel ore, including both the limonite layer and the saprolite layer, with the majority of production supplied to domestic smelters in Indonesia.

eksplorasiPage.in_december_2022_pt_hebei_geologikal: In December 2022, PT Hebei Geologikal Indonesia (HGI) completed a geological survey and issued a report. The main findings are as follows:
eksplorasiPage.the_exploration_company_delineated_an_ar: The exploration company delineated an area of 50 hectares for geological survey work, divided into two exploration zones (B4W and B1W-B2W). The primary works completed included: Topographic survey covering 0.95 km²; Profile survey totaling 17.86 km; Specialized geological survey covering 0.95 km²; Construction of 253 drill holes; Basic analysis of 4,973 samples; Measurement of 253 engineering points. Based on the exploration within the designated area, the estimated nickel ore resources (Ni ≥ 1.30%, controlled + inferred) amount to 2.726 million tons of ore, with an average grade of 1.49%. Controlled resources: 1.907 million tons, average grade 1.49%; Inferred resources: 0.819 million tons, average grade 1.49%.
eksplorasiPage.according_to_the_latest_2025_exploration: According to the latest 2025 exploration data, within an area of 212.99 hectares:
eksplorasiPage.at_an_average_nickel_grade_of: At an average nickel grade of 1.0%, the estimated reserves amount to 29.81 million tons of ore.
eksplorasiPage.at_an_average_nickel_grade_of_57: At an average nickel grade of 1.5%, the estimated reserves amount to 9.02 million tons of ore.
eksplorasiPage.based_on_exploration_in_the_designated: Based on exploration in the designated area, estimated nickel ore resources (Ni ≥ 1.30%, controlled + inferred) total 2.726 million tons of ore, with an average grade of 1.49%. The breakdown is as follows:
eksplorasiPage.controlled_resources_1_907_million_tons: Controlled resources: 1.907 million tons, average grade 1.49%
eksplorasiPage.inferred_resources_0_819_million_tons: Inferred resources: 0.819 million tons, average grade 1.49%

operasiPage.in_the_years_2023_and_2024: In the years 2023 and 2024, BMU mined and sold a total of 820,000 tons of nickel ore. This ore has an average grade of about 1.5% and a silica-magnesium ratio (Si/Mg) of about 1.8, classifying it as medium-grade nickel ore with a low Si/Mg ratio.
operasiPage.bmu_also_has_a_dedicated_jetty: BMU also has a dedicated jetty located on the coast. This facility allows barges to dock and efficiently load nickel ore for shipment.

prospekPage.new_energy_batteries_nickel_is_a: New Energy Batteries: Nickel is a core raw material in ternary lithium batteries (NCM/NCA). With the rapid growth of electric vehicles (EVs), global demand for high-nickel cathode materials continues to rise.
prospekPage.stainless_steel_industry_currently_aroun: Stainless Steel Industry: Currently, around 70% of global nickel consumption is used in stainless steel production, which remains the primary demand driver. As the world’s largest stainless steel producer, China has a high dependency on Indonesian nickel ore.
prospekPage.indonesia_holds_the_world_s_largest: Indonesia holds the world’s largest nickel reserves and production, accounting for more than 22% of global reserves.
prospekPage.the_government_has_implemented_a_nickel: The government has implemented a nickel ore export ban encouraging domestic smelting and fostering the development of nickel pig iron (NPI), stainless steel, and new energy battery industries.
prospekPage.significant_investment_by_chinese_enterp: Significant investment by Chinese enterprises in smelting and battery plants has created a strong industrial cluster effect (notable examples include the IMIP and Weda Bay Industrial Parks).
prospekPage.new_energy_wave_with_the_rising: New Energy Wave: With the rising penetration of electric vehicles worldwide, demand for nickel used in power batteries is projected to increase by 3–4 times by 2030 compared to 2020.
prospekPage.industrial_clustering_sulawesi_and_maluk: Industrial Clustering: Sulawesi and Maluku are developing a complete nickel industry chain. The strategic location of BMU in the heart of this region provides a significant geographical advantage.
prospekPage.capital_inflows_major_companies_from_chi: Capital Inflows: Major companies from China (Tsingshan, Huayou), South Korea (LG), and Europe (BASF) have already invested in Indonesia, signaling strong and growing demand for nickel ore supply.

kesimpulanPage.as_a_nickel_mining_company_based: As a nickel mining company based in Central Sulawesi, Indonesia, PT Bumi Morowali Utama (BMU) is well-positioned to benefit from the continued growth of the global new energy and stainless steel industries, thanks to its strategic location and abundant resources.
kesimpulanPage.bmu_remains_committed_to_strengthening_l: BMU remains committed to strengthening lawful and compliant mining operations, advancing exploration and mining technologies, and actively protecting the local environment. At the same time, the company strives to establish stable partnerships with downstream smelting and battery enterprises, ensuring long-term and sustainable development.
